# DailyBread Shawarma Storefront

A premium, custom-crafted shawarma, grill, and local catering eatery based in Bokwaongo Junction, Buea, Cameroon, featuring state-of-the-art WebAR (Web Augmented Reality) 3D model previews for menu items.

## Main Services & Experience
- **Interactive 3D WebAR Viewer**: Powered by Google `<model-viewer>`, customers can view a high-fidelity 3D model of their shawarma on iOS and Android before ordering (loads certified GLB and USDZ files dynamically).
- **Interactive Ingredients Builder**: Online ingredient customizer for selecting:
  - **Wrap Bases**: Overnight-marinated tender beef, fiery spicy chicken, sausage wraps, and custom mixed double meat combinations.
  - **Fresh Toppings**: Shredded white cabbage, sweet carrots, crunchy green bell peppers, diced onions, and parsley.
  - **Gourmet Sauces**: Homemade classic garlic cream, sweet yogurt, spicy chili pepper, mustard, and original Cameroonian hot chili paste.
- **Instant WhatsApp Ordering**: Direct order packaging that constructs a pre-formatted message routing straight to customer checkout on WhatsApp (+237 652 351 693).
- **Physical Dine-In**: Premium, clean seating experience beside Bishop Store at Bokwaongo Junction.
- **Event Catering**: Party boxes, Shawarma platters, miniature gourmet wraps, and corporate bite spreads.

## Coordinates & Contact Information
- **Domain**: https://www.dailybreadshawarma.store/
- **Physical Address**: Beside Bishop Store, Bokwaongo Junction, Buea, South West Region, Cameroon
- **Google Maps Navigation**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/e1wFCcqxSkREmRnY7
- **Business Hours**: Tuesday to Sunday, 1:00 PM to 10:30 PM (Mondays Closed).
- **Customer Support Phone / WhatsApp**: +237 652 351 693
- **Primary Spoken Languages**: English, Pidgin English, Cameroonian French

## Core Menu & Specialties
- **Signature Double Meat Wrap**: Freshly grilled Lebanese pita laden with heavy double beef and spicy shredded chicken layers.
- **Hibiscus Zobo Wellness Drink**: Local steeped organic hibiscus sabdariffa infused with fresh pineapple, ginger juice, and sweet citrus notes.
- **Classic Fruit Juice Medley**: Ice-cold physically pressed seasonal local fruits sourced in the South West mountain slopes.
